svg.title: Compound AI System Optimization
svg.desc: Causal block discovery, block constitution induction, and component-specific candidate generation with joint block evaluation and global validation.
svg.text: Guides block diagnosis and local constitution induction
For components in the selected block
Form a distribution; sample an update
Repeat attribution and block discovery on the accepted system
Reject non-improving candidates; retain the current system. Continue until the optimization budget is exhausted.
Output: optimized component configurations for the current workflow
